calculation.description: Takes the inverse of each asset's volatility-normalized five-day return and scales it by the ratio of short-term to medium-term realized volatility. The signal emphasizes reversal after an abnormal recent volatility shock while retaining a bounded, interpretable construction. All inputs are lagged through the decision date.

validation.regime_notes: Positive five-day IC in every tested regime: 2020-24 +0.037304, 2025-27 +0.040901, 2028-29 +0.028337, and 2030-04-02 +0.008219. Recent effectiveness weakened, so monitor drift conservatively. The ten-day extension failed the ICIR gate (IC +0.020747, ICIR +0.067262) and is not admitted.
